ruleset.name: search-ranking-optimizer
ruleset.description: Size/complexity rules for spryker-community/search-ranking-optimizer. Runs alongside phpmd-public-methods.xml and phpmd-parameter-list.xml as SEPARATE phpmd invocations — PHPMD merges every loaded ruleset's exclude-pattern into one global file-ignore list for a single run, so keeping each rule's own Facade/Factory/Mapper exemption in its own ruleset (run separately) is the only way to exempt just that one rule without also hiding those files from the rules below.
